claude_proposed_widenings.name: class_feature_acquisition_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature requires choosing one permanent passive branch at level acquisition, but current class-feature mechanics only support passive, activation, and composite without a build-time choice node.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have dedicated yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.class_list_pick
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current spell-access surface names concrete spell ids only. This feature instead grants one extra cantrip chosen from the Cleric spell list.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You know one extra cantrip from the Cleric spell list.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: dice_delta_ability_modifier_with_minimum
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current ability-modifier delta can express Wisdom modifier scaling, but not the printed minimum floor of +1.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The bonus equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).
